The '''Thulia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of [[Thulian vapor]], a mixture of post-industrial [[Atmosphere/Legends|airborne]] pollution and [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] fog.<ref name="RedHarvest">[[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Thulian vapor]]|system=Thulia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thulia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
